title: A Close Quasar Pair in a Massive Galaxy Merger at z = 5.7
question: Is J2037–4537 a physical close quasar pair in a galaxy merger at z=5.7 rather than a doubly-imaged lensed quasar, and what are the host galaxy properties and implied pair fraction?

what.value: Quasar bolometric luminosities (log Lbol=47.1, 46.9) and SMBH masses (3.9e8, 2.8e8 Msun)

evidence.quote: (cite: yue21) measured the bolometric luminosities of the two quasars to be $\log L_\text{bol}[\text{erg s}^{-1}]=47.1$ and $46.9$

what.value: Quasar luminosity function used to estimate N_qso=83 at 5.5<z<6 in DES

evidence.quote: Using the quasar luminosity function in (cite: mat18) and the template quasar spectrum in (cite: vb01)
We adopt a canonical dust temperature of $T_\text{dust}=47$K and emissivity of $\beta=1.6$ (cite: beelen06).

recipe.method: Split line-free channels, run tclean interactively with natural weighting
uvcontsub then tclean; extract spectra in 0.8'' circular apertures; fit Gaussian plus constant with MCMC
immoments for moment 0 over 283.534-284.301 GHz; per-pixel Gaussian fits for velocity and dispersion
Fit continuum and [C II] with singular isothermal ellipsoid plus external shear lens and Sersic sources
imstat in apertures, error from annulus 6''-12''; imfit 2D Gaussians

recipe.goal: Derive L_FIR, L_TIR, SFR, L_[CII], M_dyn
recipe.method: Modified blackbody SED with CMB correction; SFR from L_TIR; L_[CII] relation; M_dyn=1.5 R_maj sigma^2/G
N_qso=83 from luminosity function in DES area; F_pair>1/83; Poisson-Gamma posterior with flat prior
assumptions: J2037–4537 is the only z>5.5 pair in DES field

recipe.method: Chandrasekhar dynamical friction for galaxies then SMBHs
assumptions: SIS profiles, circular orbits, ln Lambda=0.93 (galaxies) and ~6 (BHs)

evidence.quote: We thus infer a pair fraction of $F_\text{pair}>1/83=1.2\%$.

not_stated_but_needed: Number of channels/channel width and velocity resolution of the [C II] cube
Cell size, image size, masks and clean thresholds
Calibrators and whether the pipeline or manual calibration was used
MCMC sampler, priors and likelihood for Gaussian line fits
PyAutoLens model setup, priors and settings
Which line-free channels were used given the line at the spectrum edge
Procedure for sigma used in M_dyn (conversion from FWHM, size inputs)
Inclination or random-orientation assumption details for M_dyn
missing_for_reproduction: Imaging parameters (cell, size, channel width, masks)
score_reason: Public single-project data, code released on Zenodo, compact recipe, but imaging and fitting settings are sparse.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, simple recipe, and numeric results in Table 1 can be rederived.
